title: Anthropic Founders Net $2B in IPO
excerpt: Anthropic's seven founders each cashed out $280 million following the company's record-breaking public offering.
body_html:
Anthropic has completed a record-breaking public offering, resulting in significant financial gains for its leadership and the company itself. During the market debut, the company's share price was upgraded to $83.

As a result of the offering, the company raised nearly $105 billion. Additionally, Anthropic's seven co-founders each cashed out $280 million, bringing the total amount pocketed by the founders to nearly $2 billion.
